# KnockDesk

> KnockDesk is an open-source, local-first desktop AI assistant for Windows 10 and 11, with a maintained source shell for Windows and macOS. It combines voice, persona, memory, skills, resident agents (AgentTown), World Monitor and computer control. Persona and memory files stay on your PC; prompts go to the AI providers you configure (Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, OpenAI, Moonshot/Kimi). First-party code is Apache-2.0. Published by OpKnock.
